items.title: AWS Systems Manager for SAP now supports SAP HANA scale-out deployments
items.summary: Until today, customers running their SAP on AWS using the scale-out architecture couldn’t rely on SSM for SAP to automate operations such as backups, Start/Stop and credentials rotations. We are excited to share that AWS Systems Manager for SAP (SSM for SAP) now supports SAP HANA scale-out deployments. You can now register a multi-node SAP […]
